appearances.title: Separate JEPAs match representations up to a rotation
appearances.summary: Yann LeCun and Randall Balestriero show that two JEPAs trained separately, one on images of a scene and one on text descriptions, can learn the same underlying representation without image-text pairs. The method matches next-token prediction's image-text alignment with 42x fewer samples, and a 109M text JEPA beats LLMs up to 72B on cross-modal alignment.
